description: Orbolo connects herd owners, ranches and beef buyers in Paraguay’s Gran Chaco. Own cattle on a working ranch, or buy grass-fed beef raised under the Orbolo Code.
Remote Rancher: your own herd on a working ranch in the Paraguayan Chaco, raised under the Orbolo Code. A ranch is released at 60% committed; nothing is paid before.
Grass-fed beef from Paraguay at conventional prices. We trade it today and are aligning a 300,000-head producer alliance behind it. Trade now for first pick.
El Tapir is Orbolo’s own farm in Paraguay’s Gran Chaco, open to visitors by appointment. See how Ganadería a Pasto grows supply, and bring your land into the system.
Talk to Orbolo about owning a herd as a Remote Rancher, buying grass-fed Paraguayan beef, or bringing your land into a managed grazing partnership.
